column5: I know I hate the trade ban they put on Mazeo, but this isn't personal.\nLifting those bans and uniting the nations would create peace.\nIsn't that our goal at the end of this, [firstname]?
column6: 我知道我讨厌他们对马泽奥实施的贸易禁令，但这不是私人恩怨。\n解除那些禁令、团结各国，会带来和平。\n这不就是我们最终的目标吗，[firstname]？

column5: Awesome, I'm glad you agree!\nThe Rebellion is founded on unity, and it's strong.\nEach nation on its own would stand {i}no{/i} chance of winning.
column6: 太好了，很高兴你同意！\n反抗军建立在团结之上，因此强大。\n各国各自为战的话，{i}毫无{/i}胜算。

column5: The Triumvirate won't be the last threat Alestia faces.\nIt's stupid to think that we'd have an eternal peace.\nWe can't band together now, only to split up after.
column6: 三人执政团不会是阿莱斯蒂亚面临的最后一个威胁。\n以为我们能拥有永恒和平是愚蠢的。\n我们不能现在团结，之后又分裂。

column5: Really? Are you sure about that?\nRemember, unity is what's giving us the strength to fight!\nWhy would we unite now, and split apart after we win?
column6: 真的？你确定吗？\n记住，是团结给了我们战斗的力量！\n我们为什么要现在团结，赢了之后又分开？

column5: Doesn't it seem a little counter-productive?\nI'm sure Alestia will face more threats in the future.\nWe're strong {i}together{/i}, so we should keep it that way!
column6: 这看起来是不是有点适得其反？\n我相信阿莱斯蒂亚未来会面临更多威胁。\n我们{i}团结{/i}才强大，所以应该保持下去！

column5: That's fine, but you {i}will{/i} have to make a choice.\nRemember, circumstances dictate that you're in charge.\nJust something to think about as we head to Peregrino.
column6: 没关系，但你{i}终究{/i}得做出选择。\n记住，形势决定了由你来定夺。\n去佩雷格里诺的路上想想这件事。

column5: You mean like cleaning, and climbing trees?\nI guess you're right, but I like to do more than that.\nI always say that making people smile is my favorite.
column6: 你是说打扫、爬树那种？\n我想你说得对，但我想做的更多。\n我总说，让人露出笑容是我最喜欢的。

column5: So if my work could keep an entire village happy...?\nWell, I couldn't think of a better job if I tried.\nI want to be more than just a Scribe-in-Training.
column6: 所以如果我的工作能让整个村庄都开心……？\n嗯，我绞尽脑汁也想不出更好的工作了。\n我想做的不只是见习书记官。

column5: Really? I'm glad to hear that!\nI always felt like I was meant for something more.\nWhen I heard about this opening, I knew right away!
column6: 真的？很高兴听你这么说！\n我一直觉得自己生来就该有更大的作为。\n听说这个空缺时，我立刻就知道了！

column5: This is my calling. I'm sure of it.\nJust keep that in mind when you make the final choice.\nI'm not sure when that'll be, but I'm ready...!
column6: 这就是我的使命。我确定。\n做最终决定时记住这一点。\n不确定那会是什么时候，但我准备好了……！

column5: I know, but The Elder is {i}way{/i} more important!\nRight now, I'm stuck here unless something happens to Valessa.\nI'd rather rise through the ranks another way, you know?
column6: 我知道，但长老{i}重要得多{/i}！\n现在，除非瓦莱莎出什么事，我就卡在这儿了。\n我更愿意通过别的途径晋升，你懂吧？

column5: You two make a good duo. I'm just unnecessary at this point.\nBut if I became The Elder? We could all work as a team.\nIt'd be like we're a Triumvirate of our own...!
column6: 你们俩是很棒的搭档。我现在只是多余的。\n但如果我当上长老呢？我们就能作为一个团队共事。\n就像我们自己组建了一个三人执政团……！

column5: That's fine. You don't have to choose right now.\nBut I'd like to think it's narrowed down to Valessa or myself.\nWe've worked with you and The Elder for our entire lives.
column6: 没关系。你不用现在就选。\n但我希望范围已经缩小到瓦莱莎或我。\n我们一辈子都在跟你和长老共事。

column5: We know how Valinorth works, inside and out.\nWe're more trained than any other candidate.\nJust keep that in mind when the time comes!
column6: 我们对瓦利诺斯的运作里里外外都清楚。\n我们比任何其他候选人都更有训练。\n到时候记住这点！

column5: I'm positive! She's doing a fine job as your Scribe.\nHaving me as The Elder would utilize my full potential!\nI don't mean to brag, but I spend a {i}lot{/i} of time with Mylus.
column6: 我确定！她作为你的书记官做得很好。\n让我当长老才能发挥我的全部潜力！\n不是想吹牛，但我跟迈勒斯相处的时间{i}非常{/i}多。

column5: As a Scribe-in-Training, I'm just held back.\nI don't think I'll ever need to take Valessa's position.\nSo why not let me take another position instead...?
column6: 作为见习书记官，我只是被埋没了。\n我觉得我永远都用不着接替瓦莱莎的位置。\n那为什么不让我去做别的职位呢……？

column5: Look. All I ask is that you think about it, alright?\nAt the end of the day, we're the two best candidates.\nThere's no election here. The choice will rest upon {i}you{/i}.
column6: 听着。我只求你想一想，好吗？\n说到底，我们是最优秀的两个候选人。\n这里没有选举。选择将落在{i}你{/i}身上。

column5: He's pretty cool, and I dig the antlers.\nI can't believe I've never spent more time with him.\nBut it makes sense, if he's always guarding the gate.
column6: 他挺酷的，我也喜欢那对鹿角。\n真不敢相信我从没多跟他相处过。\n但也不奇怪，如果他总是守着大门的话。

column5: Valessa seems to know more about him, actually.\nI guess he'll be coming with us to Mazeo...?\nMylus is going to evacuate everybody soon.
column6: 其实瓦莱莎好像更了解他。\n我猜他会跟我们去马泽奥……？\n迈勒斯很快就要疏散所有人了。

column5: Yeah, totally!\nI hope he sticks with us for a while.\nI mean, he's a guard, so he could easily fight with us.
column6: 是啊，当然！\n我希望他能跟我们待一阵子。\n我是说，他是卫兵，随时能跟我们一起战斗。

column5: Right now, we need all the help we can get.\nBut even if he doesn't join, I'm grateful for his help.\nThere's no way we'd make it to Peregrino on our own.
column6: 现在，我们需要一切能得到的帮助。\n但即使他不加入，我也感激他的帮忙。\n靠我们自己根本到不了佩雷格里诺。

column5: Well I thought so, until you just said that!\nWhat reason do we have {i}not{/i} to trust him?\nHe's been protecting Valinorth for years, remember?
column6: 在你说这话之前我是这么想的！\n我们有什么理由{i}不{/i}信任他？\n他保护瓦利诺斯好多年了，记得吗？

column5: If we couldn't trust him, he'd be our enemy.\nAnd if he was our enemy, he'd be working for The Triumvirate.\nWith everything we know, I'd say that's impossible.
column6: 如果我们不能信任他，他就是我们的敌人。\n如果他是我们的敌人，那就是在为三人执政团效力。\n以我们所知的一切，我觉得那不可能。

column5: Well, the surroundings are still pretty familiar.\nI expect it'll hit me harder once we get to Mazeo.\nI know it'll be different. But is that good or bad?
column6: 嗯，周围的环境还是挺熟悉的。\n估计到了马泽奥我会更受冲击。\n我知道那会不一样。但那是好是坏？

column5: There's one thing that worries me about all of this, though.\nWe may very well run into the man that killed our parents.\nWhether it's this \"Sovy\" guy, or the General of Mazeo.
column6: 不过有件事让我担心。\n我们很可能会碰上杀害我们父母的人。\n不管是这个“索维”，还是马泽奥的将军。

column5: It could even be one of those empty suits of armor, actually.\nThe thing is, I won't know what to do when I see them.\nI could cry and run away, or be overtaken with rage.
column6: 其实，甚至可能是那些空盔甲中的一个。\n问题在于，看到他们时我不知道自己会怎么做。\n我可能会哭着跑开，也可能被愤怒吞没。

column5: Don't let me do anything stupid, alright?\nI'm counting on you to help keep me in line.
column6: 别让我做傻事，好吗？\n我就靠你帮我管住自己了。

column5: Thanks, [firstname]!\nI know I can always count on you.\nIt's gonna be scary, but we'll face it together.
column6: 谢谢，[firstname]！\n我知道我总是能指望你。\n会很可怕，但我们会一起面对。

column5: Thanks, [firstname]!\nI know I can always count on you.\nIt's gonna be scary, but we'll face it together.
column6: 谢谢，[firstname]！\n我知道我总是能指望你。\n会很可怕，但我们会一起面对。
